PZZ700-270815-
1241 PM PDT Mon Oct 26 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a broad 1025 mb high was 600 nautical miles west of San 
Francisco and a 1014 mb low was over the northern Gulf of 
California. Northwest winds could occasionally gust over 20 
knots through this evening. Weak offshore flow, a land breeze, is
expected near shore during the nights and mornings, while brisk 
northwest onshore flow will develop for each afternoon and evening
through Thursday. Weak onshore flow will prevail Friday.

$$
